language.label: Language
captcha.label: Human check
captcha.hint: Required by the panel administrator to protect sign-in.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your panel account to continue.
forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.asideText: Enter the address on your account and we will send a reset link.
forgot.mailDisabled: Mail is not configured on this panel. Ask an administrator to reset your password.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Your reset link is valid for one hour.
reset.asideText: Pick a strong password you do not use anywhere else.
register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Fill in your details to join this panel.
register.asideText: Create an account and your servers will show up here as soon as they are assigned.
account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Password, profile and SFTP keys.
account.revealEmail: Hover or focus to reveal the address
account.name: Name
account.passwordHint: This password is also your SFTP password.
account.sshHint: Keys listed here can sign in to SFTP instead of a password.
home.title: Your servers
home.subtitle: All servers assigned to your account.
home.empty.title: No servers yet
home.empty.hint: Once a server is assigned to you, it will appear here with its live status.
server.console.title: Live console
server.console.hint: The latest output from pats, refreshed when you open this page.
server.console.empty: No console output yet. Start the server or wait for pats to report output.
server.console.placeholder: Type a command and press Enter
server.files.name: Name
server.files.error: Could not load this directory from the daemon.
server.files.hint: Click a folder to open it. Files open through the daemon's file API.
server.backups.title: No backups
server.backups.hint: Backups are created and restored by pats. The panel does not keep separate backup records yet.
server.schedules.title: No CRON tasks
server.schedules.hint: CRON tasks stored by this panel will run against the daemon schedule API.
server.users.title: Server access
server.users.hint: The owner is the only account with access to this server.
server.startup.title: Startup configuration
server.startup.hint: The command and container image pats uses to run this server.
server.startup.image.hint: Administrators can move this server to any image its egg offers. The panel syncs the change with the daemon.
server.startup.image.saved: Image updated and synced with the daemon.
server.settings.title: Server settings
server.settings.hint: Build limits and identifiers for this server.
server.sftp.title: SFTP access
server.sftp.hint: Sign in with this username and your panel account password. Suspended servers cannot connect over SFTP.
admin.games.subtitle: Nest eggs and the startup, install script and variables they give servers.
admin.games.createHint: Nest eggs are listed when you create a server.
admin.games.manualHint: Ignored when a game template is selected.
admin.games.name: Name
admin.games.author: Author
admin.games.variablesHint: One ENV=default pair per line, for example SERVER_JARFILE=server.jar.
admin.games.installScriptHint: Optional. Leave it empty when the image already contains everything: no install step runs and the server starts straight from its startup command.
admin.games.emptyHint: Add a nest egg, then pick it when creating a server.
admin.games.nestHint: Nests are TOML files in the nests/ folder. Every egg inside becomes a template; editing one stores a panel copy and leaves the file untouched.
admin.games.doneHint: One pattern per line. Leave empty to mark the server running as soon as it boots.
overview.title: Server overview
overview.subtitle: Every server you can see, grouped by its live state.
overview.running.hint: Servers online and serving players right now.
overview.failed.hint: Servers whose last install or boot failed.
admin.games.nestEditWarning: This template comes from a nest TOML file. Saving stores a panel copy: converting panel changes back to TOML is lossy, so the file is left untouched.
admin.games.noMatchesHint: Clear the search or pick another nest.
admin.games.importHint: Fetch a nest TOML file from a URL and write it into the nests folder. Preview first: nothing is written until you confirm.
admin.games.importBulkHint: A JSON array of URL strings. Every URL is fetched and listed for confirmation before anything is written.
admin.games.filesHint: Every nest file in the nests folder with its version. Deleting a file removes its eggs from the panel.
admin.games.imagesHint: The default image is preselected when a server is created; extra rows are the other choices, listed by name.
admin.games.resetConfirm: Discard the panel copy and go back to the nest file version?
admin.games.deleteConfirm: Delete this nest egg? No server may be using it.
